grc:noun:παλίρροια.html:
παλίρ-ροια (also παλιρ-οία ), Ion.παλιρ-οίη, ἡ,

grc:noun:παλμός.html:

quivering motion, πυγῆς; esp. pulsation, throbbing (on π. and σφυγμός cf. ), φλεβῶν; ὑποχονδρίου. β́; ὑπὸ κροτάφοισι, cf. : abs., palpitation of the heart, a disease, ; twitching, .
of natural phenomena, vibration, rapid motion, , , al.; of meteors, codd.; impetus of a projectile, .
in , internal vibration of bodies, Ep. I U., cf. Id. ap. (v.l.ἀποπαλμός).

resurrection, .
